settings.heading: Roasted in small batches, never rushed
settings.body: We roast in small drums, by hand, tasting as we go. Every bag is stamped with its roast date because coffee is at its best in the days just after — and we want you to taste it then.

settings.heading: Sourced with a handshake
settings.body: We buy directly from growers we know by name, paying well above the market so the people who grow our coffee can keep growing it well. Provenance you can taste, and trace.

blocks.quote: The freshest coffee I've had delivered — you can smell the roast date on the bag.

blocks.heading: Fast, tracked delivery
blocks.text: So it reaches you at its freshest.

blocks.heading: Subscribe & save

settings.heading: From one small drum roaster
settings.body: We began with a second-hand roaster in the back of a bakery and a stubborn belief that fresh should mean days, not months. Word spread one cup at a time — and here we are.

settings.heading: Relationships, not transactions
settings.body: We visit the farms we buy from, pay prices that let them invest in quality, and come back season after season. Good coffee starts long before the roaster.

settings.heading: Get the best from every bag
settings.body: Grind just before you brew, use good water, and weigh your dose. Small habits, big difference — and every bag carries our suggested recipe to get you started.

blocks.question: How fresh is the coffee?
blocks.answer: We roast to order and dispatch within 48 hours, so your coffee arrives days — not months — from the roast date, which is stamped on every bag.

blocks.question: Whole bean or ground?
blocks.answer: Both. Choose whole bean for maximum freshness, or select your brew method at checkout and we'll grind to match.

blocks.question: How does the subscription work?
blocks.answer: Pick your coffee and frequency and we'll roast and ship on schedule — 15% off and free delivery every time. Pause, skip or cancel whenever you like.

blocks.question: Do you ship perishable baked goods?
blocks.answer: Yes — baked provisions are made fresh and dispatched with next-day delivery so they arrive at their best. Availability is shown on each product.

blocks.question: What if something arrives damaged?
blocks.answer: Let us know within 48 hours with a photo and we'll replace it or refund you, no questions asked.
